label: Native playground needs host react-native-web
value: playground:native:build (uiTestServeApp throwaway worktrees) resolves node_modules from the host checkout (/Users/cloud/Documents/Work/thefactory-ui), not the sandbox /workspace. react-native-web is declared in package.json (^0.21.4) but must exist under that host node_modules. requestInstallPackage / allow + npm install in the sandbox does not fix native serve failures; run npm install on the host checkout instead. Sandbox still cannot run vite without a Rollup native binary — see also the note on serving the playground from a sandbox copy for THEFACTORY_TOOLS_DIR.
